placements.title: Operational resilience and drill readiness
placements.frame: How does the organization verify and maintain operational recovery mechanisms through active practice?

placements.title: an unrehearsed rollback is no rollback at all
placements.frame: Does the speaker treat operational recovery procedures as non-existent unless proven through regular rehearsal?
placements.why: Quinton mandates monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals under the foundational principle that unpracticed recovery capability is functionally non-existent, codified with explicit cadence and ownership.
